jobs.title: Senior/Tech Lead Backend Engineer (Managed Kubernetes)
jobs.description: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. Nebius Managed Kubernetes (mk8s) mission is to grow the Nebius cloud platform by providing a Kubernetes-native way to run AI systems with high efficiency and low operational overhead. With a single click, it provides a Kubernetes cluster on top of Nebius services for compute (VMs) and networking. In 2026, the service is scaling 10× and is expected to manage customer workloads across tens of thousands of GPU servers in more than 10 data centers. You will lead the mk8s Core team, one of three mk8s teams. The Core team owns the API, the core of the service control plane, cluster autoscaling, platform integrations, and running k8s add-ons. At Nebius, team leads are hands-on. We expect you to be a senior or staff engineer now (or earlier in your career). You will start as an individual contributor to gain context, then take on managerial responsibilities. In this position, you will be responsible to: Lead by example. Set the quality bar by spending a significant portion of your time on IC work: writing and reviewing code, leading projects, and participating in on-call rotation, incident mitigation, and post-incident analysis. Manage 4–8 mid-to-senior engineers. Provide context, coach, and give regular feedback. Mai

jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company s DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. jobs.title: Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Description QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question. This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you. jobs.title: Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Description QuantumDiamonds is building commercial quantum sensing tools for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. As our Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) , you will join the Hardware Pre-Development Team and take technical ownership of the sensing core of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDM). At the heart of your role is one question: how do we get more performance out of the NV sensing system? You will work across the complete sensing chain — from the diamond sensor and laser excitation through microwave spin control and bias magnetics to fluorescence collection and camera readout. When sensitivity, resolution, speed, or stability falls short, you will investigate the system end to end, identify the limiting mechanism, and turn your findings into measurable improvements. The diamond sensor itself is an important part of that challenge. Together with internal experts and external partners, you will help drive the development of our NV diamond material — connecting epitaxy, irradiation, annealing, surface preparation, and optical coatings to the performance we ultimately achieve at the system level. This is a hands-on R&D role spanning quantum physics, experimental hardware, and sensor development. You will take ideas from first principles through experiments and prototypes to validated technologies that can be transferred into our products. jobs.title: Value Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: About GeneralMind GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics. Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows. About the role As a Value Engineer at GeneralMind, the customer is yours from the first pitch onwards - through the close, the rollout, and everything that follows. You work at the core of our go-to-market, side by side with the founders, marketing, product, and sales ops, refining how we sell and keeping the pace high. You join a small, ambitious team and help define how we win customers and grow them across international markets. Whether you come from a generalist background or have years of selling behind you matters less than this: you pick things up quickly, you are comfortable with complex problems, and you can explain value in plain terms. The job sits where AI, SaaS, and operational excellence (supply chain, for example) meet. You will use AI tools in your daily work and get noticeably better at your job because of it. What You'll Do Take ownership of the customer after the first pitch and carry the relationship through close, integration, and later expansion. Build lasting relationships with C-level executives and their teams inside large, complex enterprises. Lead customers through deep dives and product Go-Lives, then keep the relationship growing over time. Develop a thorough understanding of what our customers struggle with, particularly in operational areas such as supply chain. Work closely with product engineers and founders

jobs.description: Cambridge, UK| Full-time | Permanent | Hybrid  Salary: £61,500 to £80,000  About us   Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology.  It’s a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.   Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and governments to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast About the role   We are looking for an exceptional Product Marketing Manager to lead the positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for Deltaflow , our real-time quantum error correction (QEC) system. Deltaflow is a critical component in the quantum computing stack, enabling the ultra-fast data processing and decoding required to correct errors in quantum computers in real time with high accuracy and throughput. This is a unique opportunity to join a world-leading deep-tech company at a pivotal stage of market development. You will sit at the intersection of engineering, product, customers, and commercial strategy, translating highly technical innovations into compelling value propositions for quantum computing companies, national laboratories and HPC centres.  You will help us craft the value proposition and marketing plan for each of our partners. What you will do   Oversee Deltaflow’s product marketing strategy, positioning, messaging architecture and customer value

jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company s DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. Why this role? The biggest shift in search in 20 years. Answer engines are changing how people discover software. You'll be one of the people defining what winning looks like there, with real traffic and real signups to prove it. Builder, not ticket-filer. You'll work directly with dedicated engineering and ship changes yourself. No long queues between an insight and a live fix. Real ownership. Organic search for lovable.dev is yours: the strategy, the roadmap, and the numbers

jobs.description: About Summit: Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence. Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including: Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI. HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC. HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC. Colorectal Cancer (CRC) HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy. Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland. Overview of Role:   The Senior Specialist

jobs.description: EggAI · Banking transformation programme (UK) · Remote, UK-facing — London for gate weeks About the Programme EggAI is the transformation partner on a core banking system replacement for a client to lay the foundations of operating Agentic Generative AI in production. EggAI's role is to specify, set the standard and programme-manage. You will define what operational readiness means and prove it at each gate, working with the client's own teams and its managed service providers, as well as EggAI's platform engineers. The platform is a mix of classical banking infrastructure and agentic AI workloads, so the reliability problem runs across both deterministic and probabilistic systems. The Role Own the definition of operational readiness for go-live: what "ready to run in production" means, how the bank proves it at each regulatory gate, and what has to change in the organisation for that proof to hold. The bank's operations teams, processes and provider contracts were built to run classical banking infrastructure. Agentic AI workloads need a different operating model, and you will shape it: redraw responsibilities between the client's teams and its managed service providers, set the standards each party works to, and lead the people through the change — so that those who run the platform today are ready and willing to run what comes next. This is a lead/principal position reporting to the Programme Plan and Execution Lead. It is remote, with regular London presence required for gate weeks and workshops. Vous recherchez un poste de direction alliant pilotage opérationnel, management, amélioration continue et conduite de projets de transformation ? Rejoignez nous ! JACIR - société du groupe COFINAIR qui regroupe 4 sites production en France, en Allemagne et en Italie, 290 personnes pour 70M€ CA – se positionne aujourd’hui comme le partenaire incontournable Européen en proposant des technologies innovantes de refroidissement évaporatif respectueuses de l’environnement : design, fabrication, commercialisation, Services dédiés aux tours de refroidissement et refroidisseurs adiabatiques pour l’industrie et le tertiaire. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Directeur des opérations. Garant(e) de la performance du site, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la production, de la maintenance et de la Supply Chain, et conduisez les projets de transformation qui soutiendront la croissance de JACIR. Vous exercez ces responsabilités dans un cadre exigeant, où la sécurité, la qualité et la conformité aux référentiels MASE, ISO 9001 et ISO 19443 sont au cœur de chaque décision. Ce poste est basé à notre site d’Hautot-sur-Mer puis Criquetot-sur-Longueville (76) : Missions : • Diriger l'ensemble des activités de production du site et en garantir la performance globale : coûts, qualité, délais, productivité et satisfaction client. • Garantir la sécurité des personnes, la conformité réglementaire et l'ancrage de la culture QHSE, dans le respect des référentiels MASE, ISO 9001 et ISO 19443. • Assurer la fabrication et la livraison des produits conformément aux exigences clients et aux standards du groupe. • Piloter la planification, les méthodes, la maintenance, la Supply Chain et les démarches d'amélioration continue. • Élaborer et suivre les budgets, les investissements et les indicateurs de performance du site.

jobs.company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
jobs.description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA,

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. jobs.description: About Shiftbase We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way. We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual. Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt. Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time. You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human. Year one, in order First, ship. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself. Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zoetermeer en onze hub in Amsterdam werken 85+ collega's aan een product waar bedrijven blij van worden. De sfeer? Open, informeel en hands-on. Hier geen eindeloze vergadercycli. Wel korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen en ruimte om jezelf te zijn. Wat ga je doen? De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort. Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. jobs.title: Elektronik-Ingenieur
jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale , not just in the

jobs.title: Robot Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Why this role is exciting Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows. We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match. We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job. You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them. What you will own and deliver The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong. Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap. The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows. The first training runs. jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading. These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges. The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted. What You'll Own Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery. jobs.description: Become a Part of ACCURIDS Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! At ACCURIDS, we’re building the data backbone behind life-science innovation — a system that identifies, links, and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP. We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely, and with better patient outcomes. At ACCURIDS, you’ll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one. How you’ll make an impact: You set up, maintain, and troubleshoot customer installations , managing both high-standard SaaS environments and restrictive customer on-premise deployments. You operate and scale our core AWS infrastructure , managing multi-account environments, EKS, RDS, S3, networking, and IAM. You support our development team with product operations , maintaining and extending GitLab CI/CD pipelines, driving declarative GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Kargo), and managing incident response. You develop the Accurids SaaS platform stack , focusing on enhancing platform automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), identity management, and advanced observability. You drive our security operations , building out our compliance posture through log reviews, vulnerability scanning, active monitoring, alerting, and supporting ISO 27001 requirements. You ensure operational resilience and continuity , working as a key senior pillar to transition our infrastructure from a single-point-of-failure risk to a robust, well-documented architecture. What helps you succeed: Adaptability & Continuous Learning: A strong engineering mindset with a proven ability to pick up new tools, architectures, and methodologies rapidly as our ecosystem evolves. Cloud & Infrastructure Foundation: 3–5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with production exposure to a major cloud provider (we use AWS, but Azure or GCP experience is just as welcome). jobs.title: Senior Consultant Cybersecurity (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Als Senior Consultant Cybersecurity bist Du Teil des Kernteams, mit dem wir unsere Cybersecurity-Präsenz im Raum Frankfurt–Stuttgart–München aufbauen. Du bringst Expertise in einem oder mehreren unserer Leistungsschwerpunkte mit und unterstützt sowohl bei der operativen Ausführung als auch bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots. Unser Cybersecurity-Bereich befindet sich im strategischen Aufbau – mit dem Ziel, in wenigen Jahren ein führender Beratungsanbieter für digitale Resilienz in der DACH-Region zu sein. Du hast jetzt die Chance, diesen Geschäftsaufbau fachlich, strukturell und operativ mitzugestalten. Aufgaben Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unseres Cybersecurity-Standorts in Stuttgart und gestaltest Strukturen und Prozesse aktiv mit. In Deiner Tätigkeit übernimmst Du die Beratung zu Governance-, Compliance- und regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001), bereitest Audits vor und vermittelst Entscheidern in Workshops die zentralen Handlungsfelder. Im Bereich Offensive Security übernimmst Du die Planung und Durchführung von Penetration Tests, steuerst das Schwachstellenmanagement und führst Re-Tests ausschließlich innerhalb der EU durch. Im Rahmen des Secure SDLC begleitest Du Projekte mit Architektur-Reviews, Secure-Coding-Coachings, Security-Checks in CI/CD-Pipelines sowie der Durchführung von SAST- und DAST-Analysen. Du arbeitest an Projekten in hochregulierten und sicherheitskritischen Bereichen (Finanzwesen, KRITIS, öffentliche Verwaltung) und kooperierst dabei in einem internationalen Delivery-Modell mit unseren Teams in DACH, Schweden und Ägypten. Durch die Erstellung von Methoden, Templates und Best Practices legst Du die Grundlage für eine nachhaltige und effiziente Arbeitsweise unseres neuen Cybersecurity-Bereichs. Du unterstützt im PreSales bei der Erstellung von Angeboten, beim Scoping sowie bei Kundenpräsentationen. Qualifikation Du hast Dein Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik erfolgreic

Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen. Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns. Egal, ob Du bereits Kommunikationsprofi bist oder einfach Lust auf etwas Neues hast und als Quereinsteiger bei uns durchstarten möchtest - wir bieten Dir einen spannenden Arbeitsplatz im Kundenservice mit vertrieblichen Herausforderungen. Aufgabenbereich Kundenbetreuung: Als freundlicher und kompetenter Ansprechpartner bearbeitest Du Anfragen zu unseren Hosting-Produkten und und Fragen rund um das Vertragswesen per Telefon, E-Mail und Chat. Kundenorientierung: Mithilfe moderner Technologien stellst Du eine qualitativ hochwertige Kundenerfahrung sicher. Beratung und Verkauf: Als Customer Champion erkennst Du Potenziale, um unsere Kunden individuell und bedarfsgerecht zu beraten und ihnen passende Dienstleistungen anzubieten. Weiterbildung: Interne Schulungen machen Dich zum Profi in der Kundenkommunikation und unserer Produktpalette. Qualifikationen Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du kommunizierst gerne und sicher per Telefon, E-Mail und Chat. Dabei mischst Du Beratung und Vertrieb zu einer einzigartigen Kundenerfahrung

jobs.title: Prescriptions Support Coordinator
jobs.description: At Montu, we are on a mission to transform access to medical cannabis treatment across the UK, and we are growing fast! We are looking for a Prescription Support Coordinator to join our team in King's Cross, London. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy, fast-paced environment, has exceptional attention to detail and enjoys being part of a team that makes a genuine difference to patients' lives. You do not need previous pharmacy experience. What matters most is your ability to work accurately, stay organised and bring a positive, proactive approach to everything you do. If you are looking to be part of an ambitious, growing business where your work really matters, we would love to hear from you! About the Role As a Prescription Support Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting our prescription operations, ensuring patient requests are reviewed accurately, processed efficiently and managed in line with our established procedures. You will be responsible for reviewing a high volume of prescription requests, contacting patients to discuss alternative prescription quantities and ensuring their preferences are accurately recorded. Working closely with our clinical and operational teams, you will help keep our prescription processes running smoothly while delivering a positive and professional patient experience. This is a fast-paced, process-driven role that requires excellent attention to detail, consistency and the ability to maintain accuracy when completing repetitive tasks. While you will not be making clinical decisions, you will need the confidence to recognise when something requires clinical input and escalate appropriately. What You Will Be Doing Reviewing and processing a high volume of prescription requests, ensuring accuracy and adherence to established procedures. Contacting patients by telephone, email or messaging platforms to discuss alternative prescription quantities and accurately record their preferences.

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs. Contexte scientifique : La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029). Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données ( data centers ) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude. Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux — de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement — et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux — de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement. Vous piloterez les travaux d’IMT Atlantique sur l’évaluation et la réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D avec pour principales missions : Auditer les biais de la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir d'images 2D. jobs.description: Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Aujourd'hui, nous avons un budget d'environ 255 millions d'euros, avec 4794 employés dans le monde. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. CONTEXTE : La Direction des Programmes Internationaux (DPI) de Humanité & Inclusion comprend entre autres 5 Directions Géographiques, 4 Directions Techniques, 1 Direction Atlas Logistique et 1 Direction Urgence. La Direction Urgence est composée de 15 personnes: une équipe en charge de la veille, de l'alerte et de la préparation aux urgences et une équipe en charge des interventions d'urgence au niveau du siège et sur le terrain. jobs.description: AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ? AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital , créée en 2007. Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production. Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Data Engineering, IA générative et LLM. Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets à forte valeur ajoutée pour faire de la Data un véritable levier de transformation. Nous intervenons auprès de clients aux secteurs d’activité variés, sur des missions qui combinent enjeux techniques, Data, IA et transformation opérationnelle. Selon votre profil et vos affinités, vous pourrez contribuer à des projets allant de la conception de prototypes jusqu’à la mise en production de solutions IA robustes, sécurisées et maintenables. Nos clients évoluent notamment dans les secteurs du Luxe, du Retail, des Télécoms, de la Banque, de l’Assurance et de l’Industrie . Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques techniques variées. Conception et orchestration de plateformes multi-agents : mise en place d’architectures dans lesquelles plusieurs agents IA spécialisés collaborent pour résoudre des problématiques complexes, par exemple en combinant recherche d’informations, synthèse et exécution de code, afin d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle.
